audience: courier and delivery companies that dispatch on-demand orders and routes with CXT Software

useCases.title: Track a shipment by tracking number
useCases.text: The AI tracks orders and route stops by parcel reference, barcode or Reference1 and Reference2, and returns status events and proof of delivery as far as your login allows.

useCases.title: Search orders and route stops by place or date
useCases.text: The AI searches orders and route stops by address, city, state, postal code or date range, and opens single orders with charges and proof of delivery.

useCases.title: Check whether drivers can be planned
useCases.text: The AI checks drivers for vehicle and HR violations, and one driver against specific orders for missing capabilities such as Hazmat or Lift Gate. You see who is unavailable.

useCases.title: Propose a plan for orders or routes
useCases.text: The AI proposes which driver takes which orders, or a new stop order for existing routes, and can re-optimize one plan. It shows times, distance and unassigned stops. Nothing is dispatched.

useCases.title: Dispatch an approved order or route plan
useCases.text: The AI saves a plan you approved. Orders go to drivers, or route stops are moved and re-sequenced, and drivers get the work in the driver app.
